contradictions.what: Rep says nothing could be done and it was decided before the room, yet also says our analysis was useful, had fixable findings, and arrived three weeks late after the test finished.
CFO approval was two weeks before the last call, yet the rep only learned of the evaluation at renewal, and the analysis was still being delivered; timing of decision versus engagement is unclear.
Rep calls the account healthy and not on anyone's list, but no business review for 9-10 months and rep did not know a head of payments existed.
Rep says nobody wanted to rip anything out and US stayed, but the customer moved international volume to local acquiring and asked to split the contract.
Stefan says he heard from Stripe only when he said he was leaving, while rep says there was no contact with Stefan before the renewal; the quote's context is unclear.

dodges.question: When did you first feel this was lost? What happened right before?

dodges.question: Which part of our pitch got a reaction, and which got silence?
